name: The Tobacco Road Rivalry
description: The most storied rivalry in college basketball. Duke and North Carolina, separated by just 8 miles on Tobacco Road, have produced countless classic moments since 1920.

name: The Bluegrass Rivalry
description: Kentucky and Louisville divide the Commonwealth. This in-state showdown pits two of the winningest programs in history against each other.

name: The Border War
description: Rooted in Civil War-era conflict, Kansas vs Missouri is one of the oldest and most bitter rivalries in all of sports, dating back to 1907.

name: The Tobacco Road Sibling Rivalry
description: North Carolina and NC State share a fierce in-state ACC rivalry. The Wolfpack faithful live to upset their big brother from Chapel Hill.

name: The Hoosier Rivalry
description: Indiana and Purdue battle for Big Ten supremacy and state bragging rights in one of the conference's longest-running and most passionate rivalries.

name: Big East Classic
description: Georgetown and Syracuse defined the golden era of the Big East. Ewing vs Pearl, Thompson vs Boeheim — this rivalry shaped modern college basketball.

name: The Crosstown Showdown
description: UCLA and USC are crosstown rivals in Los Angeles. The Bruins' dynasty dominance has fueled decades of fierce competition with the Trojans.

name: The Michigan Rivalry
description: Michigan and Michigan State is the biggest rivalry in the Big Ten. Wolverines vs Spartans splits the state and fuels year-round debate.

name: Blue Blood Clash
description: Kentucky and Indiana, two of the sport's most decorated programs, have produced unforgettable matchups including the iconic 1992 "The Shot" game.

name: The Blueblood Showdown
description: The two winningest programs in college basketball history. Kansas and Kentucky have combined for 11 national championships.

name: Duke vs Kentucky
description: Two titans of the sport. Duke and Kentucky have met in some of the most memorable NCAA Tournament games ever, including Laettner's iconic 1992 shot.

name: WCC Showdown
description: Gonzaga and Saint Mary's battle for West Coast Conference supremacy. The Gaels are the only WCC team that consistently challenges the Bulldogs' dominance.

name: Kentucky vs Tennessee
description: The SEC's longest-running basketball argument. Kentucky owned the series for most of a century; Tennessee's rise under Bruce Pearl and Rick Barnes turned it into a genuine two-way fight for the conference.

name: Kentucky vs Florida
description: The SEC's title fight of the modern era. Billy Donovan's back-to-back champions and John Calipari's one-and-done juggernauts met with the conference crown on the line again and again.

name: Duke vs Maryland
description: For two decades the nastiest game on the ACC calendar. Cole Field House and Cameron Indoor traded miracle comebacks, Final Four runs and a 2002 Maryland title before the Terps left for the Big Ten.

name: Duke vs NC State
description: Two Tobacco Road neighbors with a long memory. NC State's 1974 and 1983 champions and Duke's dynasty years give the series more history than its lopsided recent stretch suggests.

name: The Sunflower Showdown
description: In-state rivals since the 1900s. Allen Fieldhouse and Bramlage Coliseum are two of the loudest rooms in the sport when these teams meet, and Kansas State's upsets of top-ranked Kansas are state folklore.

name: The Crosstown Shootout
description: Two schools three miles apart in the same city, playing one of the most intense non-conference games in America every winter. Decades of close finishes, a few brawls, and no love lost.

name: Villanova vs Georgetown
description: The 1985 national championship game, Villanova's perfect night against Patrick Ewing's Hoyas, is the sport's most famous upset, and the Big East series has carried that charge ever since.

name: UConn vs Syracuse
description: The old Big East's heavyweight bout. The 2009 six-overtime classic at Madison Square Garden is the longest game in conference tournament history, and both programs own multiple national titles.

name: Bedlam
description: Bedlam on the hardwood dates to the early 1900s. Oklahoma State's Henry Iba era and Oklahoma's Billy Tubbs and Blake Griffin years gave each side its stretches of dominance.

name: The Lone Star Showdown
description: The state of Texas's flagship rivalry, interrupted when the Aggies left for the SEC in 2012 and renewed in 2024 when the Longhorns followed. More than a century of games between Austin and College Station.

name: The Duel in the Desert
description: Tucson versus Tempe. Arizona's run as a national power since Lute Olson has made the series lopsided on paper, which only makes Arizona State's upsets in Tempe louder.

name: Arizona vs UCLA
description: The game that decided the Pac-10 for a generation. Lute Olson's Wildcats and UCLA's blue-blood tradition met in a conference title race nearly every March, and now continue it in the Big 12 era's shadow.

name: The Cy-Hawk Series
description: Iowa City and Ames split the state, and the December meeting routinely produces the loudest crowd either building sees all season. The series has been close for decades.

name: The I-94 Rivalry
description: Milwaukee and Madison, an hour apart on Interstate 94, playing a non-conference grudge match every December. Al McGuire's Marquette and Bo Ryan's Wisconsin each had their eras of control.

name: Memphis vs Tennessee
description: The two biggest programs in the state spent long stretches refusing to play each other, which tells you how much the games mean when they happen. The 2008 meeting of top-ranked Memphis and No. 2 Tennessee was the biggest regular-season game in state history.

name: The Holy War
description: Provo versus Salt Lake City, a rivalry with religious and cultural lines running through it. Utah's 1998 national runner-up and BYU's Jimmer Fredette era are the modern high points of a series that goes back to 1909.

name: The Commonwealth Clash
description: Charlottesville and Blacksburg have met for more than a century. Virginia's Tony Bennett era, including the 2019 national title, tilted the series, and Virginia Tech's upsets in Cassell Coliseum are the Hokies' answer.

name: Alabama vs Auburn
description: The Iron Bowl rivalry, carried onto the court. For most of its history a football state's afterthought, it became one of the best games in the SEC once Bruce Pearl and Nate Oats turned both programs into national contenders.

name: Georgia vs Georgia Tech
description: Athens and Atlanta, 70 miles apart, playing a non-conference rivalry with roots in the 1900s. Georgia Tech's 1990 Final Four team and Georgia's Dominique Wilkins years headline the history.

name: Xavier vs Dayton
description: Fifty miles of Ohio highway and decades of Atlantic 10 and Midwestern Collegiate Conference battles. Both programs sell out their arenas for each other, and the series has flipped with every change of coach.

name: The Backyard Brawl
description: The Backyard Brawl moved indoors every winter for a century. The Big East years, with Jamie Dixon's Pitt and Bob Huggins' West Virginia, produced a run of games that decided conference seeding and bragging rights across the state line.

name: Ohio State vs Michigan
description: The Game, in basketball form. The Fab Five and Jerry Lucas's Buckeyes are the famous names, but the series has decided Big Ten titles in a dozen different decades.

name: The Border Battle
description: Madison and Minneapolis have met more than any other pair in the Big Ten. Minnesota's 1997 Final Four team and Wisconsin's run under Bo Ryan and Greg Gard define the modern chapters.

name: Florida vs Florida State
description: The Sunshine Showdown, played every December with football-scale bitterness. Florida's national titles and Florida State's Leonard Hamilton era make it two major programs with little to agree on.

name: The Apple Cup
description: Seattle and Pullman, the two ends of the state, have played since 1905. Washington's run of NBA lottery picks and Washington State's Tony Bennett years gave the series its modern highlights.

name: The Civil War
description: Eugene and Corvallis, 45 miles apart, with games dating to 1903. Oregon State's Ralph Miller era and Oregon's rise under Dana Altman, including the 2017 Final Four, are the chapters people remember.

name: The Holy War (Philadelphia)
description: Two Catholic schools in the Philadelphia Big 5, with the Palestra as the stage. Saint Joseph's 2004 run to a No. 1 ranking under Phil Martelli and Villanova's national titles frame the modern series.

name: Braggin' Rights
description: A neutral-site December game in St. Louis that both fan bases treat as a holiday. The series has been played in the city since 1980, and the trophy, and the bragging, last a full year.
